source.title: [GoodBounty-QA]: Bridge-widget QA
source.body:
# Bridge widget independent QA bounty

Test [PR #266](https://github.com/GoodDollar/GoodWidget/pull/266) against [issue #257](https://github.com/GoodDollar/GoodWidget/issues/257), focusing on what users see, understand and do. Deliver an evidence-backed report, not code fixes.

**Independent human testing and a funded live-wallet transfer are mandatory., read below after assignment how to request for testing funds.** Automated tests, fixtures and the author's earlier transfer do not replace them.

Reward: Its part of the main bounty for building the bridging widget. Tiered at: `Mythic`. Read up on reward distribution [here](https://docs.gooddollar.org/for-developers/contributing/open-source-contributors/payments-for-reviews-contributors-and-qa)

## Setup

Follow the [GoodWidget QA guide](https://github.com/GoodDollar/GoodWidget/blob/main/docs/qa-guide.md) for setup, execution and reporting. Its updated instructions must be committed before relying on them through this link. Record the guide revision used.

The candidate checked on 5 November 2026 is `edehvictor/GoodWidget:fix/bridging-correctness-257` at `8feadd7d59948c924a7d2195a1f556d9355ad4fd`. The Lead must confirm the assigned SHA. Record it, the installed SDK version and environment; keep retests on later commits separate.

Use Storybook runtime fixtures for deterministic/error states that you can not force or replicate through live testing.
Injected Wallet Demo in storybook is for live testing (browser wallet). Currently not yet having a reown wallet-connect story so this is not able to be tested.

Test desktop and 390 px mobile width, including 390 × 504, in light/dark themes. Run the guide's setup/build checks and focused suite: `pnpm test:demo tests/widgets/bridging-widget`. Record blockers and actual outcomes; skipped CI is not a pass.

## Required cases

For each case, record **Pass, Fail, Blocked or Not run**, actual versus expected behavior and fresh screenshots/video or logs. Label evidence live or mocked and human or automated. Expand route-sensitive cases for each agreed route/provider.

### QA01 First use and connection

**How:** Open disconnected; inspect balances and actions, open History/FAQ, connect, then exercise an unsupported wallet network.

**Expected:** Bridge remains visible, balances are placeholders and Connect Wallet is primary. Purpose, next step and network guidance are clear; connection does not leave stale account data.

### QA02 Routes and providers

**How:** Change source/destination independently of the wallet network. Try same-chain/unsupported pairs; inspect balances, quotes, chain names and provider availability.

**Expected:** Values follow the selected source; invalid pairs cannot proceed. Axelar supports Celo↔Ethereum, not Fuse↔Celo. LayerZero choices match supported routes. Selection never prompts a wallet switch.

### QA03 Amounts and fees

**How:** Test typing/paste, MAX, empty/zero/invalid/below-minimum/over-balance amounts and insufficient native balance. Cover Fuse/Ethereum and Celo as source/destination.

**Expected:** 2-decimal Fuse/Ethereum and 18-decimal Celo amounts remain accurate throughout. Invalid amounts cannot proceed. G$ protocol fees, received amount and buffered native-token provider fees are distinct and understandable. Verify live fees using live quotes, not fixture numbers.

### QA04 Review and Confirm

**How:** Select a source different from the wallet network, enter an amount, open Review, then Confirm. Inspect route, provider, received amount, costs and switch guidance.

**Expected:** Selection and Review do not prompt a switch. Confirm switches if needed, refreshes the quote and submits once. The user understands the next wallet action and required network support. See the [confirmed flow](https://github.com/GoodDollar/GoodWidget/pull/266#issuecomment-6570885978).

### QA05 Rejection and recovery

**How:** In fixtures, reject switching/approval; simulate quote, preparation and submission errors, then Retry.

**Expected:** Rejected switching causes no subsequent quote/submission for that action. Retry uses a fresh quote and submits once. Cancellation, preparation failure and on-chain failure are distinguished, with clear recovery and no false success.

### QA06 Stale state and interruptions

**How:** Change amount/route/source/account during quoting, preparation and mocked switching. Dismiss/reopen Review, change tabs and repeat-click Confirm. After submission, change account/source and fail a history refresh.

**Expected:** Changed inputs invalidate stale preparation and prevent wrong/duplicate submissions. Already-submitted transfers remain available; refresh failure does not erase them.

### QA07 Progress and delivery

**How:** Exercise submitted, pending, failed and delivered states; open source/provider/destination links and Continue in background.

**Expected:** Source confirmation is not destination delivery. Status, remaining steps and return path are clear. Links match the transaction/network; pending or failed states do not imply success.

### QA08 History

**How:** Inspect loading/empty/error/populated/pending states; open pending details. Observe polling, failed status lookup and source selection changes.

**Expected:** Pending details are read-only, without another Confirm action. Polls do not repeatedly rescan every chain or replace the list with a full spinner. Lookup failures retain entries. Amounts, chain names, timestamps and links are accurate.

### QA09 Mobile and accessibility

**How:** Repeat the primary flow at the required viewports/themes. Check keyboard access, control names, Escape/outside-click dismissal, focus return, touch targets and contrast.

**Expected:** Review, switch guidance, Confirm and progress/history links remain readable and reachable, particularly at 390 × 504. Record clipped, inaccessible or misleading UI and its user impact.

### QA10 Design comparison and UI regression

**How:** Compare fresh running-build captures with the original [main Bridge](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ce20a10c-ce40-44c3-9b7f-55225d3d63fb), [confirmation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f46b7ba-e5c8-4f57-aee6-b576522bf616) and [progress](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7c90b14-4e1d-4f36-856d-0aee9a797113) designs, the [Lead's notes](https://github.com/GoodDollar/GoodWidget/pull/266#issuecomment-6359719680), and current PR screenshots. Match route, amount, connection, viewport/theme and delivery state where possible.

**Expected:** Document every meaningful difference or regression in hierarchy, copy, fees, controls, layout, progress and mobile usability. Check existing design-system treatment, separate protocol/provider fees, provider chain choices, History naming, no unsupported estimated time, overlay/drawer progress, shared Stepper/loader and reopening pending details.

Provide a reference-versus-result table with screen/state, links, difference, user impact and proposed triage. Distinguish regressions, approved changes and deferred features; explain unmatched states. Fuller From/To rows and accessibility follow-ups in #257 still need impact reporting, not automatic expansion into implementation work.

### QA11 Independent live transfer

**How:** Using the agreed funded plan below, the independent human tester completes each approved route/provider, including at least one full transfer. Capture initial balances, quote, wallet prompts, allowance if required, submission, source receipt, provider tracking, destination receipt and final received amount. Navigate away and return through History.

**Expected:** Wallet requests match the reviewed transaction and agreed limits. Submission occurs once. Only confirm delivery when destination records and received amount support it. History retains accurate status/links. Pending/failed delivery is reported as such, never passed based solely on source confirmation.

### QA12 Live rejection and retry

**How:** Before broadcasting, safely reject a real switch prompt where available and an approval/transaction confirmation; inspect the UI and retry within the funded plan.

**Expected:** Rejection broadcasts no transfer, creates no false success and does not trap the user. Retry uses current state and a fresh quote without duplication. Record unavailable paths honestly; use fixtures for deliberately failing on-chain scenarios.

## Live testing and Telegram funds
**When starting, request test funds through the confirmed Telegram contact/group before any live transaction.**. You can reach out in our goodbounties channel: https://t.me/gooddollarbounties/4115

Provide a fresh walkthrough with redacted wallet-prompt evidence, quoted/actual amounts and fees, transaction/provider links and destination confirmation. The author's old transfer and mocked recordings do not meet this requirement.

## Report and acceptance

Use the [qa-guide](https://github.com/GoodDollar/GoodWidget/blob/main/docs/qa-guide.md) and [shared QA report template](https://github.com/GoodDollar/.github/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/GoodBounties-QA-Template.md). Include the tested versions/environment, QA01–QA12 results, live-transfer record, UI regression table, reproducible findings, evidence, automation gaps and an **Accept/Hold/Retest** recommendation. Keep author, automated and independent human evidence separate.

A failed case is a valid finding; blocked/unrun cases remain open gaps. Record retests against their own SHA. The tester confirms execution, reviewer completes technical review, Lead accepts or holds QA, and maintainer records final sign-off or hold. Any exception needs a dated reason and follow-up owner; it is not a Pass.

Fixes, shared-component changes, merging and deployment are outside this bounty.

comments.author: HushLuxe
comments.text:
Full-stack developer applying for this QA bounty — independent human testing of PR #266 against issue #257, focusing on what users see, understand and do, delivered as an evidence-backed report, not code fixes.

**What this bounty asks for**
PR #266 (edehvictor/GoodWidget:fix/bridging-correctness-257, head 8feadd7d59948c924a7d2195a1f556d9355ad4fd) claims to fix the per-chain decimals, wallet-gate and chain-selection bugs in #257. My job is to verify that claim independently: run the widget as a user would, test every case QA01–QA12, and report Pass / Fail / Blocked / Not run with fresh screenshots, video and logs — keeping live, mocked, human and automated evidence separate. Automated tests, fixtures and the author's earlier transfer do not replace independent human testing, so I will not rely on them.

**How I will test it — case by case**
- Setup: check out the PR head, record the exact SHA with `git rev-parse HEAD`, the installed @goodsdks/bridging-sdk version and environment, and follow docs/qa-guide.md (recording the guide revision used). Run the guide's setup/build checks and the focused suite `pnpm test:demo tests/widgets/bridging-widget`. Storybook at http://localhost:6006, desktop and 390 px mobile (including 390 × 504), light and dark themes. The Lead to confirm the assigned SHA; retests on later commits kept separate.
- QA01–QA02 (first use, routes/providers): open disconnected and confirm the Bridge stays visible with balances as placeholders and Connect Wallet primary; connect, then exercise an unsupported wallet network. Change source/destination independently of the wallet network, try same-chain and unsupported pairs, and check provider labels — Axelar only Celo↔Ethereum; LayerZero must list its actual chains (Celo, Ethereum, Fuse, XDC), not just "LayerZero".
- QA03 (amounts and fees): typing/paste, MAX, empty/zero/invalid/below-minimum/over-balance amounts and insufficient native-token fee. The core correctness check is per-chain G$ decimals — 2-decimal G$ on Fuse (122) and Ethereum (1) versus 18-decimal on Celo (42220) and XDC (50) — staying accurate through input, balance/MAX, quote, protocol fee and amount received, with the displayed provider fee matching the amount actually charged. The relevant code is packages/bridging-widget/src/adapter/chains.ts (getChainDecimals), amount.ts, useBridgeQuote.ts (400 ms debounce, parseUnits from viem) and FeeBreakdown.tsx.
- QA04–QA06 (review/confirm, rejection, stale state): select a source different from the wallet network, open Review, then Confirm — selection and Review must not prompt a switch; Confirm switches if needed (the confirmed flow in PR #266 comment 6570885978), refreshes the quote and submits. Reject switching/approval in fixtures and check no quote or submission follows for that action; change amount/route/source/account mid-quote and mid-preparation and confirm stale preparation is invalidated and already-submitted transactions are preserved. Relevant code: BridgeConfirmModal.tsx, ReviewScreen.tsx, useBridgeSubmission.ts, adapter/submissionSteps.ts.
- QA07–QA08 (progress, history): exercise submitted, pending, failed and delivered states and open source/provider/destination links — source confirmation is not destination delivery. In History, check loading/empty/error/populated/pending states, confirm pending details are read-only with no second Confirm action, that polling does not rescan every chain, and that failed status lookups render as pending, not dropped. Relevant code: BridgeProgress.tsx, HistoryTab.tsx, BridgeHistoryDetailModal.tsx, useBridgeHistory.ts, historyTransactions.ts.
- QA09–QA10 (mobile/accessibility, design comparison): repeat the primary flow at the required viewports/themes, checking keyboard access, control names and Escape/close behaviour. Compare fresh running-build captures against the original main Bridge, confirmation and progress designs and the Lead's notes (PR #266 comment 6359719680), in a reference-versus-result table (screen/state, links, difference, user impact, proposed handling). Differences found against #257 get impact reporting, not automatic expansion into implementation work.
- QA11–QA12 (live transfer, live rejection): request test funds first through the confirmed Telegram channel (https://t.me/gooddollarbounties/4115) under the agreed funded plan, then complete each approved route/provider transfer as an independent human tester — initial balances, quote, wallet prompts, allowance if required, submission, source receipt, provider tracking, destination receipt and final received amount — navigating away and back through History. Delivery confirmed only when destination records and the received amount support it; pending/failed delivery reported as such, never passed on source confirmation alone. Before broadcasting, safely reject a real switch prompt where available and an approval/transaction prompt, and confirm no transfer is broadcast and no false success is created. Use the Injected Wallet Demo story in Storybook for live browser-wallet testing; note the Reown wallet-connect story does not exist yet, so that path is recorded honestly as not testable.

**Evidence and validation**
Per case: Pass/Fail/Blocked/Not run, expected vs actual, and fresh screenshots/video or logs labelled live vs mocked and human vs automated. The final report follows the qa-guide and the shared QA report template, with tested versions/environment, QA01–QA12 results, the live-transfer record, the UI regression table and an Accept/Hold/Retest recommendation. I will post the report on PR #266 and link it from this issue. A failed case is a valid finding; blocked/unrun cases stay open gaps.

**Scope boundaries**
Reporting only — fixes, shared-component changes, merging and deployment are outside this bounty and QA does not authorise them. Out of scope per #257: the SSR guard in register.ts, explicit From/To rows on Confirm, Playwright baseline diffing in CI, verifying cloudflare-eth.com as a live RPC endpoint, and the upstream @goodsdks/bridging-sdk getChainHistory issue (tracked separately in GoodSDKs). The pending-history detail drawer behaviour is decided, not a bug.

**Relevant previous work**
GoodDollar/GoodWeb3-Mono issue #259 — "Refactor: support connected wallets" (closed, PR #260 merged) — connected-wallet work directly relevant to the wallet-gating and chain-switching behaviour this QA exercises.

**Availability and ETA**
I can start immediately on assignment. ETA: 7 working days for the full QA01–QA12 pass, live transfers and report (the live-transfer timing also depends on agreeing the funded plan with the Lead), with an initial status update within 24 hours of assignment. I will report progress and blockers here on GitHub, and you can reach me via GitHub comments.

Hi @L03TJ3, I'd like to request assignment for this QA bounty.

I've reviewed issue #277, PR #266 and the original requirements in issue #257.

I understand that this is an independent human QA task, not a request to implement fixes. My goal will be to verify the bridging experience from a user's perspective and provide an evidence-backed report covering all twelve required cases.

My testing plan:

1. Set up the confirmed PR revision locally, record the commit SHA, SDK version and QA guide revision, and complete the required setup and build checks.
2. Test QA01–QA08, covering wallet connection, routes, providers, amounts, fees, confirmation, rejection, transaction progress and history.
3. Test QA09–QA10 across desktop and 390px mobile layouts, in light and dark themes, including accessibility and reference-design comparisons.
4. Complete QA11–QA12 independently using an approved funded test wallet, requesting test funds through the designated Telegram channel before any live transaction.
5. Document each result as Pass, Fail, Blocked or Not run, with fresh screenshots, recordings, logs and transaction evidence as appropriate.

I'll clearly distinguish live human testing from mocked and automated results, and will not present unverified scenarios as passed.

ETA: 7 working days from assignment, subject to test-fund approval and availability, with an initial progress update within 24 hours.

I'll provide the completed QA report on PR #266 and link it from this issue, including an overall Accept, Hold or Retest recommendation.

Thank you for considering my application.
